title: Mini Cotton Muslin Buffing Wheel Set with 3.175mm Shank Mandrel, 1 Inch, for Dremel Rotary Tools, Jewelry, Metal & Chrome Polishing (2, 3.175, Millimetres)
description: Bring back the original shine to your precious items with this Professional Mini Cotton Muslin Buffing Wheel Set. Crafted from soft cotton muslin material with 16-ply stitched construction, these 1-inch (25 mm) buffing wheels deliver smooth, scratch-free polishing results that last. The secure metal centre lock prevents wheel loosening during use, ensuring consistent and safe performance every time. Fitted with a 3.175mm shank mandrel, these wheels are compatible with most rotary tools including Dremel tools, mini drill machines, hand rotary tools, and DIY craft machines. The compact size makes them ideal for precision work on small areas and intricate details. Perfect for jewellery polishing, watch cleaning, metal finishing, chrome shine restoration, silver cleaning, and DIY craft work. Suitable for gold jewellery, silver items, brass parts, metal crafts, and chrome accessories. Easy to install in just a few steps — simply insert the mandrel, attach the buffing wheel, tighten securely, apply polishing compound, and start buffing. Ideal for both home and professional use.
